name: Aura of the Seraphim
description: Reduces darkness by 50. At the start of battle, grants all allies Radiant Blessing (+50% status immunity, +30% damage against Undead, +15 flat damage reduction, +5% HP regeneration per turn). Each turn, cleanses 1 negative effect from every ally. Basic attacks heal the ally with the lowest HP for 50% of the damage dealt (overhealing becomes a holy shield). Intercepts 35% of enemy AoE damage for same-row allies.
